title: DONALD TRUMP: THE SWORD OF GOD

sense.text: “And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.” Are we free today? Hell no. Do we know the truth today? Not as a nation, no. Israel is not free because Israel as a nation does not know the truth.

precepts.why:
“Sanctify them through thy truth”: sanctify the Israelites through thy truth, mainly the elect, the apostles Christ was speaking of. Then: “thy word is truth.” The word is the truth.

So the truth that makes us free is the word of God. Then let us see what the word says.

sense.text:
This is the word that is the truth, and the word says “the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven.” The day is coming that is going to burn like an oven. Nuclear fire is coming to America. How are you going to survive that?

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: you are going to be stubble in that day, burnt up, lest ye repent.

“It shall leave them neither root nor branch”: your children will be cut off too.

precepts.why:
“Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.” That sounds just like Malachi 4: the day that shall burn as an oven.

“Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.” That is the “neither root nor branch” of Malachi 4. Their children are destroyed with them.

Why? “For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.” They are imagining evil devices and evil counsels against us, but the Lord says they are not able to perform them.

“Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers”: for the sins of their forefathers. Your forefathers committed the crime, got the bag from us, took the wealth, took everything from us, and now you have been left holding the bag. Esau, and not just Esau: Elam, Ishmael, the Hammites. All of them got wealthy off the backs of the Israelites; all of them had us in slavery one way or the other.

“That they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities. For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew.” Son and nephew: that goes right back to Psalms 21, “their seed from among the children of men”, and to the end of Malachi 4:1, neither root nor branch.

sense.text: “He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.” This is the same as Psalms 21: the devices they imagined, which they are not able to perform.

“He taketh the wise in their own craftiness.” The crafty are the nations, in particular Esau, that counsel against us and continue to exploit, oppress and colonize with imperialism.

“And the counsel of the froward is carried headlong”: the froward are these nations in their secret councils. They are going to fall headlong and bust their foreheads.
“They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.”

“But he saveth the poor from the sword”: from Esau’s sword, the nations’ sword, “from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.” The poor are Israel.

But before all this persecution ends and the Lord saves us, something has to take place first: we have to identify who the wicked is.

precepts.why:
“What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” Write it down: when the scripture talks about the poor, it is talking about Israel, “the poor of his people.”

So the poor that the Lord saves from the sword in Job 5:15 are the Israelites.

sense.text: “That ye be not soon shaken in mind, or be troubled”: do not be shaken, do not be troubled, “as that the day of Christ is at hand.” That day is the day of Christ, when he comes back in flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God.

“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first.” The day of Christ will not come until Deuteronomy 28 is fulfilled: Israel first has to go into captivity for the evil they did.

“And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition.” The man of sin has to be revealed throughout the whole entire planet earth. He is the son of hell, the devil on earth. Esau has to be revealed: everybody needs to know and agree that this man is the man of sin.

Watch how he is being revealed. Trump tells the Iranian protesters that one death is too much, while his buddy Netanyahu has murdered over 200,000 with Trump’s bombs. He puts tariffs on anybody doing business with Iran and says help is on its way. He defines winning by Venezuela, by Al-Baghdadi, by Soleimani, and by the bombing of Iran. Machado gave her peace prize to Trump for attacking Venezuela and kidnapping its leadership, and agreed to privatize all of Venezuela’s resources. The United States has bombed country after country since World War II, and has removed leader after leader for their oil, copper and uranium, or for nationalizing them: Maduro, Gaddafi, Saddam Hussein, Lumumba and the rest. America is the most powerful villain. That is Mystery Babylon the Great. Netanyahu visits Trump, and 48 hours later Trump is ready to start another war with Iran, while he gives blind support to Israel as they massacre the Palestinians.

precepts.why:
This is the falling away. “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword”: the Israelites fell by the edge of the Romans’ sword. We fell in 70 AD. “And shall be led away captive into all nations”: we fell away into captivity and were dispersed into all nations.

“And Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles.” So Netanyahu is a Gentile. That is what Christ said. The fake Jews are Gentiles, thus saith the Lord. They are not the people of God. The people starving out the Palestinians and bombing them, and causing all kinds of ruckus in Iran, are not the children of God.

So the falling away has already come: Israel fell to the sword and went into captivity. What remains is for the man of sin to be revealed.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man”: the nations that see Esau will look at him and say, Is this the nation? Is this really Babylon, the great nation Babylon?

“That made the earth to tremble”: that dropped bombs everywhere, on us, on this one and that one, all over the earth. “That did shake kingdoms.”

This is the man of sin being revealed: the whole earth looking upon him and considering him.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: this is what Esau, America, has done all throughout the earth. “He that ruled the nations in anger”: by dropping bombs, by force, by devastation, genocide, colonization and imperialism. He “is persecuted, and none hindereth.”

“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When Esau is taken out, the whole earth is going to be at rest, at peace. “Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” Esau is not going to be able to go into the rainforest of South America, chop down the trees and make a golf course. That is going to be over.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”, because you are coming down. “It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations. All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?” When America is destroyed, the Congo and Venezuela are going to say: damn, you are just like us now, just like the other nations.

“The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor.” Which nation is more proud than America? Not one. Trump was bragging that his military could destroy any nation and fight multiple wars at the same time. America sent 150 fighter jets to Venezuela at one time, when Venezuela has 21 fighter jets in its entire fleet. They got Maduro in two to three hours; not one American was killed. They only waited for the weather to break.

“For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire”: Trump boasts, We are going to take Greenland, and nobody can do anything about it, a NATO country. He said they would do it whether Greenland likes it or not, the easy way or the hard way. The Greenlanders are having nightmares about him. Trump is stirring up the world. Give the Lord a hand.

“And blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth”: they are associates and allies with the coveters. They are the coveters, and they push that in the earth. “The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God.”

“His ways are always grievous”: Esau’s ways, America’s ways, Trump’s ways. “As for all his enemies, he puffeth at them”: he mocks Venezuela, Iran, China. I have the strongest military in the world; what are you going to do to me? “He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity”: Make America great again.

“His mouth is full of cursing”: you cannot tell me this is not talking about Trump. At a motor plant in Dearborn, Michigan, a worker yelled out pedophile protector, and he said F you. “And deceit and fraud”: he talks about liberating the Iranian people, but he wants the oil and the resources and the regime change for his handler Netanyahu, who is pulling the strings. As soon as he meets with Netanyahu, all of a sudden he cares about the Iranian people.

This is the wicked, the man of sin, revealed before the whole world.

sense.text: “The charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth.” That is what we need in the body: the brothers and the sisters to be charitable, and for that charity amongst each other to abound.

“So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God”: others on the outside will see your charity towards each other and glory in you. “For your patience and faith”: all our faith needs to increase. “In all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure”: we must maintain charity and love one for another while going through the persecutions and the trials, and endure those things.

Going through those things and enduring them shows “that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which ye also suffer.” You are going to suffer for the kingdom of God, and in your suffering you still must maintain love for your neighbor. It is not about you or about one man. It is about the body of Christ.

“Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you.” We are not just supposed to turn the other cheek. The ones troubling the apostles at Thessalonica were Rome. That is the context.

“And to you who are troubled rest with us, when the Lord Jesus shall be revealed from heaven with his mighty angels, In flaming fire taking vengeance on them that know not God.” Christ is coming back for vengeance. That is never taught in church, but it has been in the Bible since before any of us were here. This is the New Testament.

“And that obey not the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.” They do not obey the gospel. The majority of our people just finished celebrating New Year’s; a week before that it was Christmas, a month before that Thanksgiving, a month before that Halloween. Every year they keep repeating the same evil. By now they know these things are evil and not of God, and they choose the wickedness.

precepts.why:
“Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence.” That is the recompense and the vengeance just read in 2 Thessalonians 1: the Old Testament says the same as the New.

“He will come and save you.” He is coming to save the Israelites. He is not coming for Christians, not for the Baptists, not for any denomination. He is coming for the Israelites.

sense.text: “And behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter”: that is us. “And on the side of their oppressors there was power.” That is what they have on us: power. They organize themselves, they pass laws and policies, they colonize, they oppress, they exploit. “But they had no comforter”: the Israelites had no comforter.

“Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.” King Solomon praises the dead because of verse 1: we have no comforter, and on the side of our oppressors is all the power. They are holding all the cards right now. Solomon would rather praise the dead than be oppressed daily.

“Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun”: better is he that has not gone through the oppression. The dead are not going through it; the living are depressed, oppressed, suppressed, pressed all kinds of ways.

precepts.why:
What is supposed to comfort us? “For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning”: this Bible was written for our learning. We ought to learn from what happened to the Israelites, to the apostles and to Christ.

“That we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.” The scriptures are our comforter. That is what we need to hope in.

Job is going through tribulation: his wife is on him, his children are dying, he has the skin disease, he has lost his lands, he has lost everything. So he says, “Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?” Why didn’t I just die already? Why am I still here?

“For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest.” If he had slept, meaning been dead, he would have been at rest, and not going through the hell he is going through. “Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light”: stillborn.

“There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest. There the prisoners rest together”: we are the prisoners. “They hear not the voice of the oppressor.” The dead do not have to deal with oppressors any more. That is why Solomon praised the dead more than the living.

sense.text:
King David says, “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say”: the Lord who was on Israel’s side. “When men rose up against us”: when the nations rose up against us.

The only reason we are still breathing is the mercy of the Lord. With the weapons Esau has and the weapons the nations have, if the Lord gave them free reign with us, we would all have been wiped out.
“Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us”: the nations would have swallowed us up.

“Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.” The waters are not the waters of affliction. The waters are the nations: the proud nations would have gone over our souls.
“Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth”: because of the Lord’s mercies.

“Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped”: escaped out of their hands, due to the mercies of the Lord. But how do we overcome this beast? Only by the blood of the Lamb.
“Our help is in the name of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.” That name is God’s commandments with faith in his Son.

precepts.why:
“It is of the Lord’s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.” It is only because of the Lord’s mercies that we are still here. His compassions fail not. “They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness. The Lord is my portion, saith my soul.”

That is why David says, if it had not been the Lord who was on our side: he is the reason we are still standing.

“The Lord is longsuffering.” This is one of the characteristics we must take on: being longsuffering with our brothers and our sisters. We are carnal and have no patience with each other. A brother offends you, or does what you think is an offense that he may not even see as one, and you get all in your feelings. Sisters get in their feelings about something somebody said or the way somebody moves towards them. You have to be longsuffering. We are all different spirits joining together for one common goal. We are not all going to get along, but we all have to be longsuffering with each other and endure.

“And of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty.” Why great mercy, yet by no means clearing the guilty? To get that great mercy you have to repent and forsake your sins. Those that do not repent are not cleared: “visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.”

So the Lord who is on Israel’s side is the Lord of great mercy, and it is of his mercy that the nations have not swallowed us up.

Here is the precept for the waters of Psalms 124. “Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” It is talking about nations.

“The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters”: he is comparing the nations to waters. “But God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.”

So the proud waters that would have gone over our soul are the nations, and God shall rebuke them.

“The waters which thou sawest”, where Babylon sits, where America sits, “are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.”

Look at the map of where America sits: America does not have to send its entire fleet to Russia or to China. It is already there. Look at the weaponry. If I were Trump, I might boast too. These are the waters, the nations, that would have overwhelmed us if the Lord had not been on our side.

How do we overcome? “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb”: they overcame Esau, Satan, the nations. That is the only way we are going to overcome: by the blood of Christ. By his blood being shed we have a chance at everlasting life.

That is how the snare is broken and we escape.

sense.text:
What do we have to do to really escape this? “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness.” The promise is that this place will burn like an oven. It is coming one way or the other. No man knows the day or the hour, but trust and believe it is coming.

“But is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.” That is what the Lord wants: all to come to repentance. That is how we escape.

precepts.why:
What is the promise? “Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts.” Scoffers are all over TikTok and all over YouTube. When Druski did a skit on the Christians, hardly any Christian videos answered it; but when he did a skit on us, all the critics laughed. Did Druski lie? Hell no. He held a mirror up to you: what Druski did is Christianity to a tee. And when he did it on us, he said Christmas is evil, that we have to keep the law, that Esau is the devil. He told the truth. Druski did not go against the Father or against Christ. He went against your dumb ass and your evil.

You apologetics, you black Christians, you walk after your own lusts. You are not following the Lord; you are following your slave master and your slave master’s doctrine. There are pages full of nothing but AI videos of us, purple and gold, on and on. These devils can’t sleep. We are constantly on their brain. Keep doing it, because brothers and sisters will look at your page, then run up on the teachings and say: these brothers are right. We are the Israelites. We have to keep God’s commandments. Esau is the devil the Bible speaks of.

“And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.” Since our ancestors fell asleep. That is the promise the Lord is not slack concerning: this place will burn like an oven.

“As I live, saith the Lord God, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked”: the wicked of our people. “But that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?”

Turning from your wicked ways is repentance. That is the repentance the Lord is longsuffering for in 2 Peter 3:9: he is not willing that any should perish.

“From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.” After the dove landed on Christ and he had the spirit of the Lord, this is how he began his ministry. Compare that to Christianity today. Do Christians teach like that? Hell no. They teach the laws of God are done away with.

If you teach the laws of God are done away with, how do you escape the destruction to come? That is not going to work.

“Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God”: literally. “We ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device”: idols.

“And the times of this ignorance God winked at”: he had mercy and was longsuffering with us. “But now commandeth all men every where to repent”: all Israelite men everywhere. Saying three Hail Marys and waiting for Christ to beam you up is not repentance.

sense.text:
“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired.” The Bible tells the Israelites to gather together, not to be separate individuals. That is for all of you online that like to stay home and say you don’t like camps. Do what God said to do. Come in, learn, sit down and be quiet.

A lot of you individuals are evil as hell, because it shows you love Babylon: you don’t want to gather with your people, and you have some evil in you that you don’t want everybody to see. Some say they will come to the school when they get right. You come to the school to get right. None of us are 100% right; we are all trying to get right. How are you going to get right in your wicked ass mama’s house or with your homeboys?

By not gathering you show that you love Babylon, and you are delaying the coming of Christ. You are okay with white Jesus, okay with Babylon, okay with black people getting shot down in the street and our people on drugs. You are not coming into a body of believers and building yourself up.
“Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you”: that is the day of the Lord once again.

So what should we do? “Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment.” We have wrought the judgments of God: Deuteronomy 28, the curses. “Seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.”

precepts.why:
“Gather the people”: that is the gather together, O nation not desired, just read. “Sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.” There is going to come a time when persecution is going on, and we are not going to be worrying about wedding ceremonies.

“Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord”: spare them from the persecution. “And give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?”

So the gathering is not optional. In that day the priests gather the people, call for a fast and pray, spare thy people.

“In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan”: the language of Canaan is the scriptures. The judgments are going to be going out heavy in this particular place.

“In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt.” What is done on an altar? Killing. They are going to put some of us to death in the midst of the land of Egypt, in America.

“For they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors”: they are the Israelites, those priests read of in Joel 2:17 crying, spare thy people. “And he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.”

That is the day of the Lord’s anger, and why we must seek him now, that we may be hid.

sense.text:
“A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth.” America is that treacherous dealer. They deal underhanded: CIA, Mossad, guerrilla warfare, mercenaries like they do in Haiti. They colonize because they want your resources. They want to monopolize the resources of the entire planet earth, the resources of all the dark nations.

Jeffrey Sachs, an American economist who has advised more than a hundred governments and seen CIA coups with his own eyes, calls the United States the most lawless and dangerous country in the world. This is a white man saying this about his own country. Israel and the CIA, meaning America, are causing the riots in Iran: paying protesters, with Mossad in the protests shooting people with Israeli weapons. Trump says he wants to protect the Iranian people, but he kicked them off the SWIFT payment system and imposed the sanctions that crippled their economy.

Salute to Deacon Malachi, who brought this out in his class last week: America puts embargoes and sanctions on a country, the country cannot recover, and the people get upset at their president and want regime change. They bypass the one who caused the problem with the sanctions.

They took out Gaddafi because he wanted to unite Africa on the gold standard and they wanted his oil and his sovereign wealth. In Libya a check from the oil would hit your bank account like clockwork; we have never experienced anything like that in the so-called greatest country in the world. What happened in Libya is what will happen in Iran if there is a regime change under America and Israel. That is how the treacherous dealer deals.

precepts.why:
“Therefore hear the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Edom”: in this context Edom is the USA, America. “And his purposes, that he hath purposed against the inhabitants of Teman”: Teman is Amalek, the so-called Israel.

“Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: Israel, Amalek, is the least of the flock, and shall draw America out into World War III. “Surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.”

Compare it with Jeremiah 49:20. “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon”: in Jeremiah 49 it says Edom; here it says Babylon. That is America. “And his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans”: in Jeremiah 49:20 it was the inhabitants of Teman, so-called Israel.

“Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”: Amalek is going to draw America out. “Surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.”

sense.text: “The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord”: in this nation right now, in 2026, that is Donald Trump. His heart is in the hand of the Lord. “As the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” The Lord turns this man’s heart whithersoever he wants. Whatever way the Lord wants Donald Trump to go, he is going to go, and he is going to fulfill what the Lord has in store.

precepts.why:
“This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men.” God is the ultimate ruler. “And giveth it to whomsoever he will”: he gives the kingdom to whomever he chooses.

“And setteth up over it the basest of men”: the least of men, the bottom feeders. The bottom feeders are ruling us right now: Biden, Trump, Putin, all of them. They are the bottom, and the Most High set them up, as he turns the king’s heart whithersoever he will.

sense.text: He is talking to Babylon now. “Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon”: Babylon is up on high, America is up on high, a proud nation. God says no, I am going to bring you down, as read in Isaiah 14: hell from beneath is moved to meet you. You are supposed to be a virgin. “Sit on the ground: there is no throne”: you are not ruling anything any more. “For thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate”, because the prophets will be revealing this devil to his face out on the streets teaching, and the world is going to know that this man is the man of sin, the son of perdition.
“Uncover thy locks”: take off that head covering; you are no righteous woman. “Make bare the leg, uncover the thigh”: you are a hoe. You are no righteous woman.

“Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen”: America, we are going to uncover your nakedness and show the whole world you are nothing but a hoe, a low down 304. “I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.” Destruction is coming to Babylon the Great.

Here comes the judgment. “But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood”: death is coming to Babylon; that fire is coming to Babylon. You are going to be a widow.

Why? “For the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments”: the evil you perpetrate throughout the earth, your LGBT, your murder, your death, your colonization, your imperialism, your genocides.

“For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me”: I am Mystery Babylon the Great, everybody loves me, everybody wants to be around me. “Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee”: your science, your technology, your weaponry has perverted you. Now all you do is drop bombs from drones.

“And thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.” I am the one, not the French, not the Arabs. I am big bad America. Nobody can do a damn thing about it; my military is in all countries.

“Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off”: there is nothing you can do about it in that day. “And desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.”

precepts.why:
Isaiah 47:9 says these two things shall come “in a moment in one day.” Revelation says the same: “Alas, alas, that great city Babylon”, America, “that mighty city”, that no other nation could defeat, “for in one hour is thy judgment come.”

That one-hour judgment is coming for America. Are you going to survive it? Are you going to put in the work, change your life and repent? Or are you going to wait it out, thinking you have a little more time? Keep playing games.

“And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high”: that is Esau in his pride, the one that said in his heart, I am, and none else beside me. “And the kings of the earth upon the earth”: the other nations too.

The Lord will punish the high ones sitting on high, and the kings of the earth with them.

sense.text: This is about who the Lord is going to punish. All the nations will be punished, and there is not a damn thing you can do about it. If the Israelites got punished, you have to get punishment too. “The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles”.

“Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh–necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah.” There is parable talk in this: it is a similitude. It is not plain. Some scriptures are twofold, threefold, fourfold.

precepts.why:
“The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.” Pharaoh smote Gaza. In 2026, right now, who is smiting Gaza? Amalek. This Pharaoh is Amalek, and the Philistines are the Palestinians.

Before that Pharaoh smote Gaza: Netanyahu, the Israelis, smote Gaza. That is the parable talk in the prophecy against Egypt and Pharaoh.

“I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.”

So the prophecy against Egypt and Pharaoh is a similitude. It is not plain, and it speaks to what is happening now.

“That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot”: the Assyrian is Amalek. Amalek will be judged. “Then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders”: Amalek’s yoke departs from off the Palestinians because they are wiped out, removed.

“This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.” All nations are going to get judgment.

“Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”: you Palestinians, do not rejoice because Amalek is moved out of the way. This is not for you to rejoice over. “For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent”: a missile.

“And the firstborn of the poor shall feed”: the firstborn of the poor is Christ. “And the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant”: thy root, Palestinians.

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved.” Palestine will be dissolved. Not only Amalek: the Palestinians have to get out of that land too. “What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.”

“Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast”: that is Gaza. “The nation of the Cherethites”: that is the Palestinians. “The word of the Lord is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.” The Palestinians are going to be destroyed out of that land, and so is Amalek.

“And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks”, when those missiles hit. “And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah.” The house of Judah will live in Gaza. That is Judah’s land. Give the Lord a hand for that. We are the house of Judah. I need a little beachfront property too.

“They shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for the Lord their God shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.” Hallelujah.

sense.text: “O thou sword of the Lord”: now we are getting back to the title of the class. “How long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.” A scabbard is the leather thing you put a sword in. How long are you going to be quiet? How long will judgment not go on? Put your sword up and be easy.

But the next verse: “How can it be quiet, seeing the Lord hath given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore?” The sword cannot be quiet: judgment has to go forth. The Lord gave you, sword of the Lord, a charge against Gaza; that is the sea shore. “There hath he appointed it.” Missiles are coming there too.

precepts.why:
This is judgment on the nations. “Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.”

The wicked is the sword of the Lord. That is the sword of Jeremiah 47:6, which cannot be quiet while the Lord has given it a charge.

sense.text: “Against Moab thus saith the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled”: destruction to Nebo. “Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.” These are places in Moab. The Lord is bringing judgment on the nations.

precepts.why:
“And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.”

That is the end of the woe against Moab: Moab destroyed from being a people for magnifying himself against the Lord.

sense.text: “Concerning the Ammonites”: Ammon, the Japanese. “Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?” Why is Gad mentioned here? Because Gad is mixed among the Mongoloids.

Because of that, “behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel be heir unto them that were his heirs, saith the Lord.” We are going to inherit. We are going to be heirs.

It is not just you, Esau: it is judgment on all the nations. “The word that the Lord spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans”: Babylon here is America, and the Chaldeans are Amalek, so-called Israel.
“Declare ye among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken”.
“Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow”: all ye that go to war. “Shoot at her, spare no arrows”: do not spare Babylon, “for she hath sinned against the Lord.”

“Shout against her round about: she hath given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.”

precepts.why:
“Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles”: the other nations. What does the Lord want them to do? “Prepare war.” China has to go to war, America has to go to war, Russia, Syria, France, Great Britain, Iran, Saudi Arabia: all these nations have to go to war. “Wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near”: all you military men, wake up. It is time to go to Armageddon.

“Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears”: make weapons for war. “Let the weak say, I am strong”: you finished boot camp; take your behind overseas and go to war.

“Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about.” “Let the heathen be wakened”: wake up, Esau; wake up, Ishmael. “And come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.” You have to go there and die.

“Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe”: it is time to go, Esau. “For the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great. Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.”

That is the array of the nations against Babylon: the Lord calls all the nations to war, and the vengeance of the Lord is done on Babylon.

sense.text: “Come out of her, my people”: come out of America’s ways, come out of their filth. “That ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues”: that you receive not the judgments of Babylon.
“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” God is remembering America’s iniquities.

“Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works”: America, you deserve double. “In the cup which she hath filled fill to her double”: the judgment she gave out, dropping bombs all over the earth on different nations, she is going to get double that.

“How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously”: lived deliciously on the resources, the minerals and the strength of all the other nations. “So much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow”, just like Isaiah 47.
“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.”
“Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” In one hour Babylon will be destroyed.

“And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more.” All the other nations are going to mourn and weep for Babylon, because there will be no more trading and no more making money with Babylon: all those corporations, all those countries.

Gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, ivory, precious wood, brass, iron, marble, cinnamon, frankincense: where are all these minerals and resources found? In all the dark nations, particularly Africa. They are not found in America. You had to colonize and drop bombs to get these things.

“And chariots, and slaves”: the slaves are the Israelites. That is us. We are here. “And souls of men”: our people’s soul is knit to America. Our people love this place and want America to last forever.
What should you do when Babylon is destroyed? “Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.” Hallelujah.

“And in her was found the blood of prophets”: in Babylon, which is America, was found the blood of prophets. Where are the prophets? Right here. You are the prophets. “And of saints”: you are the saints. “And of all that were slain upon the earth.”

precepts.why:
“Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute.”

That is why the blood of prophets and of saints is found in Babylon: the prophets and apostles sent to her, some of them slain and persecuted. That is us, here in America, and that is why God avenges us on her.
